OK so my kid has some designer clothes. The plus with those over non label is that I can resell them and get some of if not all of my money back when she out grows them. So if I get a Ralph Lauren or Patagonia jacket I just resell if for whatever I bought it for because I only buy those things on sale. However if I buy a similar jacket at Walmart I can't resell it and get the same amount of money when she grows out of it.

Honestly she doesn't. One of the things about those types of kids. Either their moms are smart and get those clothes from a consignment store or like I'm admin of a Facebook mom group and we do a clothing swap every winter and spring. 

So I guess to add insult to injury there are some seriously labeled up kids and teens whose parents didn't spend any money on their kids clothes. You're question really made me think about it. I bought a north face and polo jacket for her at consignment, but all of her other clothes name brand or not were free. So I haven't instilled in her the need to value it over her non labeled stuff.
